title: animal crossing style online multiplayer game
author: LevelStill5406
selftext:
i’ve always been a huge fan of animal crossing. the cozy vibes, engaging yet calm gameplay loop, the feel good interactions between characters. but one thing was always lackluster: the multiplayer. the best we got required 2 separate switches to play and it limited a lot of the game.

so instead of waiting for nintendo to build one, i built my own game in a similar style. using meshy for a lot of the art, characters, and rigging. while not perfect, i feel its off to a good start. spent a lot of time optimizing it too so it works on mobile devices and looks and feels good on any device. it also supports gamepads :)

i built it completely with claude code, though i have over 10 years experience as a software engineer so that helped a bit 😅

would love some feedback, it’s free to play: hiveverse.app

p.s. it’s about bees because bees are cute and cool and make delicious honey sorry not sorry

replies.body: thanks a lot! theres an extra furniture catalogue that can be paid for in credits, and you can take shortcuts to upgrade your home with credits too. but you can still upgrade via nectar (in-game currency you get from selling fish, bugs, dug up goods, and earned from contents and events)
